items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if A -> B is a smooth ring map then L_{B/A} = Omega_{B/A}[0] (source lines 1932-1935). The proof combines three inputs: the agreement in cohomological degree zero from the identification of H^0 with the differentials, the locality on Spec(B) together with the localization formula L_{B_g/A} = (L_{B/A})_g which allows the reduction to the standard smooth case, and finally the factorization A -> A[x_1,...,x_n] -> B with an etale second map, for which the vanishing statement and the localization lemma identify L_{B/A} with the base change of the polynomial algebra complex, whose cohomology is known.
